question.wording: Is this item the base rate (with its taxes and charges) of the first telephone line into the taxpayer's home?

options.label: Yes — the first home line's base rate, personal
No — a business call, an additional line or other utility

default.because: A utilities item is not the base rate of the first home phone line unless a preparer says so

citation.wording: the base rate (including taxes and other charges) for local telephone service for the first telephone line into your residence is a personal expense and is not deductible.
